presets.name: German Payslip
presets.description: German Lohn-/Gehaltsabrechnung. Detects Steuerident-Nr., Rentenversicherungs-Nr., Krankenversicherungs-Nr., IBAN, German dates, German phone numbers, German street addresses and PLZ + city.

presets.name: Italian Busta Paga
presets.description: Italian payslip. Detects Codice Fiscale, Partita IVA, Matricola INPS, IBAN, Italian dates and phone numbers, plus names, addresses. Disables the noisy 'Amounts' detector so salary figures aren't over-redacted.

presets.name: US W-2 / Pay Stub
presets.description: US tax forms and pay stubs (W-2, W-4, 1099, generic paystubs). Detects SSN, EIN, US dates, US ZIP codes, US phone numbers, bank routing numbers (context-anchored), plus names, addresses, account numbers and amounts.

presets.name: US Medical Records
presets.description: US medical records and clinical notes. Detects patient names, DOB (multiple formats), MRN (6+ digit runs without decimals), SSN, full US addresses, ZIP, emails and phones. Preserves lab values by ignoring numbers with commas/periods.

presets.name: UK Medical Records
presets.description: UK hospital and GP records. Detects NHS numbers, UK dates (dd/mm/yyyy and long form), UK postcodes, UK phones, NI numbers, hospital numbers and patient names. Preserves lab values.

presets.name: Generic Invoice
presets.description: Generic invoice or receipt. Detects invoice numbers, EU VAT IDs, IBAN, BIC/SWIFT (context-anchored), phone numbers (US and Canada with extensions, European and international), plus names, addresses, emails. Dates and amounts stay visible; toggle Amounts manually to hide totals too.

presets.name: Bank Statement
presets.description: Bank or credit card statement. Detects IBAN, BIC/SWIFT (context-anchored), masked card numbers, full card numbers (13-19 digits), transaction references, dates, phone numbers (US and Canada with extensions, European and international), plus names, addresses, account numbers and amounts.

presets.name: Common Surnames (US + Canada)
presets.description: Opt-in preset that hides ~10,400 common surnames across the US and Canada — top 10k US Census 2010 plus curated French-Canadian, Scottish/Irish-Canadian, Asian-Canadian, and Eastern European immigrant surnames very common in Canadian rosters. For guest lists, reservation calendars, employee rosters. False positives expected on common-word surnames (Brown, Green, Stone) — opt-in tradeoff.

presets.name: Italian Fattura
presets.description: Italian invoice (fattura). Detects Partita IVA, Codice Fiscale, IBAN, the SDI recipient code, Italian dates and phone numbers, plus names, addresses and emails. Amounts kept visible so line items stay readable.

presets.name: Italian Atto / Contratto
presets.description: Italian legal deed or contract (atto notarile, contratto). Detects Codice Fiscale, Partita IVA, IBAN, the notarial Repertorio/Raccolta number, Italian dates and phone numbers, plus the names and addresses of the parties and emails.

presets.name: Italian Sentenze / Atti Giudiziari
presets.description: Italian court judgments and judicial acts (sentenze, decreti, verbali, atti di stato civile). Detects codice fiscale (personal and company), partita IVA, cadastral references (foglio, particella, subalterno, categoria), vehicle plates, civil-registry act references, Italian dates in numeric and spelled-out form, phone numbers and IBAN. Court names and law citations stay readable.

presets.name: Italian Visura
presets.description: Italian company or cadastral record (visura camerale / catastale). Detects Partita IVA, Codice Fiscale, REA number, cadastral references (Foglio / Particella / Subalterno), IBAN, Italian dates and phone numbers, plus names and addresses.

presets.name: German Rechnung
presets.description: German invoice (Rechnung). Detects USt-IdNr, Steuernummer, IBAN, BIC/SWIFT, German dates, phones, street addresses and PLZ + city, plus names and emails. Amounts kept visible.

presets.name: German Personalausweis
presets.description: German ID card (Personalausweis) or passport copy. Detects the Ausweisnummer, CAN/Zugangsnummer, Steuer-ID, the machine-readable zone (MRZ), date of birth and German addresses, plus names. Pair with manual redaction for photo and signature.

presets.name: German Kontoauszug
presets.description: German bank statement (Kontoauszug). Detects IBAN, BIC/SWIFT, Bankleitzahl (BLZ), Kontonummer, German dates, phones and addresses, plus account holder names. Amounts kept visible so you can prove income while redacting identities.

presets.name: German Führerschein
presets.description: German driving licence (Führerschein) copy. Detects the Führerscheinnummer, date and place of birth, issue/expiry dates and German addresses, plus names. Pair with manual redaction for photo and signature.

presets.name: Spanish DNI / NIE
presets.description: Spanish ID (DNI) or foreigner ID (NIE) copy. Detects the DNI (8 digits + letter), NIE, the support number (IDESP), dates of birth and Spanish addresses, plus names. Pair with manual redaction for photo and signature.

presets.name: Spanish Factura
presets.description: Spanish invoice (factura). Detects NIF / CIF / DNI, IBAN, Spanish dates and phone numbers, plus names, addresses and emails. Amounts kept visible.

presets.name: Belgian Legal Documents (FR)
presets.description: Belgian legal documents in French (citations, conclusions, actes). Detects the BCE company number, cadastral references, Belgian addresses and postal codes, company names by legal form, IBAN, plus names. Amounts in € stay visible.

presets.name: US Brokerage Account Statement
presets.description: US individual brokerage account statement (Schwab, Fidelity, Vanguard, Merrill, Morgan Stanley, IBKR and similar). Removes only client-identifying data: account holder, joint holder, trustee and beneficiary names (capitals on registration lines and address blocks, or normal case after a label), account numbers in labeled, dashed, Fidelity/IBKR, partial and masked forms, SSN / tax ID (also masked), client phone numbers, the city, state and ZIP line, plus mailing addresses and e-mails from the built-in detectors. The generic name and account-number detectors are off on purpose, so security names and CUSIPs are never taken for people or accounts. Keeps account types (INDIVIDUAL TOD, ROTH IRA), security names, tickers, CUSIPs, quantities, prices, values, balances, income, fees, cost basis, gains/losses, dates, custodian names, toll-free service numbers and the advisor's name. Limits: the custodian's own street address and ZIP look like the client's and are covered too (remove them with the X), an unlabeled normal-case name without a middle initial is not detected, and signatures and QR codes need a manual box.

presets.name: German Court Order (Gerichtsbeschluss)
presets.description: German court orders, decisions and judicial correspondence (Beschluss, Urteil, Verfügung). Detects Aktenzeichen in the Roman-numeral department form (3 XVII H 1234), the standard form (12 C 345/22, 2 BvR 1/20) and after an Az./Geschäftszeichen label, labeled birth dates (geb. am 01.02.1970), German phone numbers, street addresses and PLZ + Ort, plus names and e-mails from the built-in detectors. Court names, statutes, paragraph citations, decision dates and amounts (Streitwert, Kosten) stay readable. The court's own address and phone number are covered too: untick Adresse / PLZ Ort / Telefon if you want them visible.

presets.name: Swiss Medical Records (Dossier médical)
presets.description: Swiss medical records in French, German or Italian: discharge letters, consultation reports, lab results, medical correspondence. Detects the patient's name after its label, the date of birth (né le, née le, Geburtsdatum, or in parentheses after the name), the AVS/AHV number (756…), insurance card and insured numbers, patient, dossier and case numbers, the insurer's name, GLN and RCC/ZSR identifiers, Swiss IBAN, NPA and locality, street addresses in the Swiss order, and Swiss phone numbers, plus names, e-mails and addresses from the built-in detectors. Turn on Barcodes & QR codes in the side panel to cover codes too. Keeps lab values, ICD-10 (CIM-10) and CHOP codes, examination dates and amounts. Doctors' names may be detected as well: click the X to keep one visible. Handwritten signatures are not detected: draw a manual box over them.

presets.name: French Payslip, Invoice & Tax Notice
presets.description: French bulletin de paie, facture and avis d'impôt. Detects the NIR (numéro de sécurité sociale), SIRET, SIREN, French VAT number (TVA FR), numéro fiscal, tax notice reference, employee number, IBAN, French dates, phones, street addresses and postal code + city, plus names and emails. Amounts stay visible on purpose.

presets.name: US Broker Tax Statement (Consolidated 1099)
presets.description: Year-end tax statement from a US broker (Form 1099 Composite / Consolidated 1099 from Schwab, Fidelity, Vanguard, E*TRADE, Merrill, Robinhood, IBKR and similar): 1099-DIV, 1099-INT, 1099-B, 1099-MISC and 1099-OID pages. Removes only what identifies the recipient: the account holder and joint holder names (in the address block or after a Recipient label), the street address and the city, state and ZIP line, the recipient's TIN or SSN (full or masked), account numbers in labeled, dashed, broker-specific and masked forms, client phone numbers and e-mails. Keeps everything you need for taxes or for an AI: box numbers and labels, all amounts, security names, CUSIPs, quantities, dates acquired and sold, proceeds, cost basis, gains and losses, wash sales, the payer's name and TIN and the broker's toll-free numbers. The broker's own street address is covered too (remove it with the X). Signatures and QR codes need a manual box.

presets.name: German Workshop Order (Werkstattauftrag)
presets.description: German workshop and repair orders (Werkstattauftrag, Reparaturauftrag, Auftragsbestätigung) from dealer and independent-garage systems. Hides the customer: name or company (after Herrn/Frau/Firma, in the address window, after Kunde:/Auftraggeber:/Halter:/Ansprechpartner:/z. Hd.), street and PLZ Ort, phone and mobile numbers, e-mail, every German licence plate (M-AB 1234, LÖ-X 99E, HH XY 1234H, also in free text) and only the last 6 characters of the VIN/FIN, so the first 11 stay readable. The workshop's name, letterhead, sender line, footer, switchboard number (ending in -0), fax, e-mail at workshop domains and staff names (Serviceberater:, Annahme:, Monteur:) stay visible, as do order and customer numbers, dates, km-Stand, Erstzulassung, HSN/TSN, make and model, work positions, part numbers, AW, prices and VAT. Limits: on scans and photos a name or address with no label or salutation on the same line (the address window) is not found and must be covered by hand; a workshop number without -0 (or a direct line without a Durchwahl label) is covered like a customer number; a VIN wrapped onto two lines is not recognised.

presets.name: UK Tax Return (SA100, SA302, P60, P45)
presets.description: UK Self Assessment documents: the SA100 tax return, the SA302 tax calculation and the P60 and P45 from an employer. Hides what points to you: your name and address, postcode, phone, e-mail, National Insurance number, UTR and date of birth, also when they are written one character per box, plus the bank sort code, account number and IBAN for refunds, the employer PAYE and Accounts Office references and your payroll number. Keeps what an accountant or an AI needs to read the return: every amount, box number, tax year, tax code, form name (SA100, SA102, SA302...), HMRC's own address and helpline numbers, and the employer's name (switch on Employer to hide it). Limits: on scans and photos, characters in boxes are often read one by one and can be missed, so check those fields; a date of birth after 2009 is found only right after its label; signatures need a manual box.

presets.name: US Equipment Invoice / Sales Order
presets.description: Invoices, sales orders and quotes from US machinery and equipment dealers (forestry, construction, farm, trucks and trailers), including old dot-matrix invoices scanned to PDF. Hides the customer: company and contact names, street and city lines of the Sold To, Bill To and Ship To blocks, customer phone numbers and e-mails, the customer number or code, the PO number, the tax, exemption or resale certificate number, the remarks after a Remarks, Comments, Notes or Delivery notes label, delivery and contact lines typed in capitals without a label (DELIVER TO, CALL, CUST TO SEND, PICKED UP), the lender and the loan, LN or contract number on a trade payoff, lien or financing line, the printed name of the signer, and every serial number (SER#, Serial No., S/N, SN, ESN, PIN, VIN, also 17-character PINs inside a table). Keeps the dealer's letterhead (name, street, P.O. Box, city, phone, toll-free and fax numbers, mailboxes such as sales@, web site), make, model, year, hours, warranty codes, stock numbers, prices, totals and payoff amounts, dates, terms, notes that start with the dealer's standard wording (Prices valid..., Freight...) and the invoice number (an optional pattern hides it too). The Addresses detector is off: it covered the dealer's street too. Limits: on a scan a customer's city line in mixed case (Pontiac, IL 61764) alone on its line looks like the dealer's and stays visible (switch on City line to hide it, the dealer's city line too), and a customer street in a business park (Industrial Dr.) too; on dot-matrix scans the reader often splits the Sold To and Ship To lines into single words, and a lone word or house number there needs a manual box; handwritten signatures, other notes without a label, the second line of a Remarks or Notes block (a lender or loan number on it is still hidden) and serials in a table column that are not 17-character PINs need a manual box too; makes such as John Deere can be taken for a person.

presets.name: German Medical Records (Arztbrief, Befund)
presets.description: German medical documents: Arztbrief, Entlassungsbrief, Kurzarztbrief, Befundbericht, Laborbefund, Überweisungsschein (Muster 6), Reha-Entlassungsbericht, as text PDFs or scans. Detects the name of the patient and of relatives after their label (Patientin:, Name, Vorname:, Pat.:, Betr.:, Herr, Frau, Ehemann), also double-barrelled names with umlauts and particles (Müller-Lüdenscheidt, zu Hohenstetten, van der Heyde) and surname first; doctors' names after Dr. med., Prof., Dipl.-Med., OA or Chefärztin; the date of birth in every form (geb. am 03.07.1958, geb. 3.7.58, Geb.-Dat., *03.07.1958, (*1958), 3. Juli 1958); admission, discharge and other dates; the Krankenversichertennummer, the Rentenversicherungsnummer, case, patient and order numbers, LANR, BSNR and IK; German phone and fax numbers, street and house number, PLZ and town; plus e-mails and barcodes. Keeps diagnoses, ICD-10 codes, lab values, units and doses. Turn off Arzt to keep doctors' names visible, or Date to keep exam dates (dates of birth stay hidden). Limits: the clinic's own address in the letterhead is covered like the patient's (remove it with the X); on a form where the name sits under its printed label (Muster 6) the name may stay visible; handwritten signatures need a manual box.

presets.name: Portuguese Medical Records (Relatório, Análises, Receita)
presets.description: Portuguese medical documents: boletim de análises clínicas, nota de alta, relatório clínico, relatório de imagiologia (TAC, ecografia), guia de tratamento da receita sem papel, atestado e declaração médica, as text PDFs or scans. Detects the name of the patient and of relatives after their label (Nome, Utente, Doente, Exmo. Sr., Exma. Sra., Sra. D., filha, also the English First name and Last name of exported reports), with accents and particles (da, dos, e), in capitals or surname first; doctors' and staff names after Dr., Dra., Prof., Enf.ª, Médico assistente:, Validado por:, Técnico:, and the printed name after Assinado por:, Assinado digitalmente por: or Signed by: (the date and time after it stay visible); the date of birth (Data de nascimento, D. Nasc., nascido a, Birth date); the SNS user number, NIF, NISS and Cartão de Cidadão or BI; ADSE, SAMS and insurer numbers (Médis, Multicare, AdvanceCare, Apólice, N.º Beneficiário); processo, episódio, requisição and amostra numbers and the Person ID; the receita number, código de acesso e dispensa and código de direito de opção; cédula profissional and Ordem dos Médicos numbers; phones, street, código postal and town; plus e-mails, barcodes and QR codes. Keeps test names, results, units, reference intervals, collection and exam dates, medication, doses, diagnoses and the names of hospitals, clinics and labs; 9-digit lab values stay visible, and so do the headers and values of glasses prescriptions (Esfera, Cilindro, Eixo, Adição, Esf., Cil., Adiç., OD, OE, DP, Longe, Perto, +1,25, -0,75, 90°) and the axes of audiograms. Turn off Médico to keep doctors' names visible. Limits: the clinic's own address and phone in the letterhead are covered like the patient's (remove them with the X); handwriting is covered only when the scan text reads it; handwritten signatures are covered by the Signatures detector (BlurData 1.6.5 and later).
